input: I heard the Karnataka Rent Act caps the security deposit at 2 months' rent, so my landlord must refund the rest. Right?

answer.where_you_stand: The Karnataka Rent Act does not set a specific limit of two months' rent for a security deposit. Section 17 deals with deposit of rent and other charges but does not mention any cap on the amount [KRA-s17-p2]. Section 15 provides that if any sum is paid in contravention of the Act, the Controller may order a refund to the tenant [KRA-s15].
options: Check the written rent agreement to see what it says about the security deposit amount
Talk to the landlord and ask for a refund of any amount that exceeds what the agreement allows
If you believe the deposit was excessive and contrary to the Act, you may apply to the Controller for a refund under Section 15
next_steps: Locate and read your lease agreement carefully

If the agreement allows less than what you paid, discuss the excess with the landlord

input: My landlord deducted 25,000 from my 60,000 deposit for repainting the whole flat after I lived there 2 years.

answer.where_you_stand: Under the Karnataka Rent Act a landlord may only deduct from the security deposit for damage that goes beyond normal wear and tear.  Section 47 says the premises must be kept in the same condition as when let, except for normal wear and tear, unless the written rent agreement says otherwise [KRA-s47-p1].  Repainting the whole flat after two years is usually considered normal wear, so the deduction is likely not allowed unless your lease specifically required you to repaint at the end of the tenancy.
options: Ask the landlord to return the ₹25,000, citing Section 47 of the Karnataka Rent Act.
If the landlord refuses, send a formal legal notice demanding the amount back.
If still unresolved, approach the Rent Controller/Tribunal for a dispute resolution.
next_steps: Check your rent agreement for any clause that obliges you to repaint the flat at the end of tenancy.
Gather evidence of the flat's condition when you moved out (photos, videos, inventory).
Write a polite request to the landlord referencing Section 47 and ask for the deduction to be reversed.
If no response, have a lawyer draft a legal notice on your behalf.
answer.what_i_dont_know: Whether your written rent agreement contains a clause that obliges you to repaint the premises at the end of the tenancy, and the exact condition of the flat when you vacated.
answer.lawyer_reason: A lawyer can review your lease, draft a proper legal notice, and represent you before the rent controller if the dispute escalates.

input: I gave my landlord Rs 8,00,000 as lease (bhogya) amount for our house and now he refuses to return it after the lease ended.

answer.where_you_stand: You paid Rs 8,00,000 as a lease (bhogya) amount. The lease has ended and the landlord is refusing to return the money. Section 28 of the Karnataka Rent Act requires a landlord to refund any advance rent or other payment only after he has recovered possession by exercising his legal right of eviction, which has not happened here, so that provision does not apply [KRA-s28-p2]. Section 15 allows the rent controller to order a refund only if the payment was made in contravention of the Act, which is unclear in your case [KRA-s15]. The Transfer of Property Act (summary) says the tenant must give back possession at lease end, but does not force the landlord to return a lease amount unless the lease agreement says so (summary) [TPA-s108-p3].
options: Negotiate with the landlord and ask for a written refund based on the lease terms
Send a formal legal notice demanding the return of the lease amount, citing the lack of any lawful basis for withholding it
If the landlord does not respond, consider filing a suit for recovery of money in civil court
Approach the rent controller within one year, claiming the payment was made in contravention of the Act, if you can show that
next_steps: Check your lease agreement for any clause about refund of the bhogya amount
Locate the receipt or any written acknowledgment of the payment (Section 16 requires a receipt) [KRA-s16-p1]
Draft a written notice to the landlord requesting refund within a reasonable time (e.g., 15 days)
If no response, consult a lawyer to evaluate filing a civil suit or approaching the rent controller
Keep records of all communications and receipts
answer.what_i_dont_know: Whether the bhogya amount was classified as advance rent, security deposit, or a separate premium under your lease; the exact wording of your lease regarding refund; whether any provision of the Karnataka Rent Act was breached when the payment was made
answer.lawyer_reason: amount at stake ≥ ₹500,000. A lawyer can interpret the lease terms, assess if the payment was unlawful under the Act, and guide you on filing a notice or suit to recover a large sum

answer.where_you_stand: मकान मालिक ने बिजली काटी है, जो कि बिना उचित कारण के आवश्यक आपूर्ति को रोकना है और यह कर्नाटक किराया अधिनियम की धारा 49 के तहत अवैध है। [KRA-s49-p1]
options: कंट्रोलर के पास आवेदन करके बिजली तुरंत बहाल करने और संभावित मुआवजा माँगें। [KRA-s49-p1]
मकान मालिक को लिखित नोटिस भेजें कि वह तुरंत बिजली बहाल करे, नहीं तो कानूनी कार्रवाई करेंगे।
यदि कंट्रोलर की कार्रवाई से समाधान नहीं मिलता तो नागरिक न्यायालय में आदेश (इंजंक्शन) या क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए मुकदमा दायर करें।
next_steps: बिजली कटने की तिथि, फोटो/वीडियो, और कोई लिखित संचार इकट्ठा करें।
कंट्रोलर के कार्यालय में धारा 49 के तहत आवेदन फॉर्म भरें और सबूत संलग्न करें।
एक वकील से परामर्श लें ताकि नोटिस और आवेदन सही ढंग से तैयार हो सके।
answer.what_i_dont_know: आपके किराया अनुबंध में बिजली आपूर्ति से संबंधित कोई विशेष शर्त है या नहीं, और आपने कब तक यह समस्या रिपोर्ट की है, यह नहीं पता।
answer.lawyer_reason: कंट्रोलर को आवेदन, लिखित नोटिस, और संभावित न्यायालय में दायर करने वाले दस्तावेज़ सही रूप में तैयार करने के लिए वकील की मदद आवश्यक होगी।

input: ಮನೆಯ ಛಾವಣಿ ಸೋರುತ್ತಿದೆ, ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.

intake.english_summary: The tenant reports that the roof of the house is leaking and the landlord has not repaired it.
missing_info: When did the roof start leaking?

answer.where_you_stand: ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಛಾವಣಿ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸದಿರುವುದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ಅಸುರಕ್ಷಿತಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಕಾನೂನು ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಮಾಲೀಕರು ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ, ನೀವು ದುರಸ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ, ಅದರ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಕಡಿತ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು[TPA-s108-p1][TPA-s108-p2][TPA-s108-p3] (summary). ಜೊತೆಗೆ, ಕರ್ಣಾಟಕ ರೆಂಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಅಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಒಳಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು[ KRA-s27-p3] (summary).
options: ಮಾಲೀಕರಿಗೆ ಬರಹದ ಸೂಚನೆ ನೀಡಿ, ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಮಂಜಸ ಸಮಯ ನೀಡಿ
ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ, ನೀವು ಸ್ವತಃ ದುರಸ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ, ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಕಡಿತ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು
ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ರೆಂಟ್ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ
ಕಾನೂನು ಕ್ರಮ (ಕೋರ್ಟ್) ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾಲೀಕರಿಂದ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ
next_steps: ಮಾಲೀಕರಿಗೆ ನೋಟ್‌ಪೇಡ್ ಪತ್ರ (ಅಥವಾ ಇಮೇಲ್) ಮೂಲಕ ಛಾವಣಿ ದುರಸ್ತಿಗಾಗಿ ಬರಹದ ಸೂಚನೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ
ಸೂಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಮಂಜಸ ಸಮಯ (ಉದಾ: 15-30 ದಿನ) ನೀಡಿ
ಸಮಯ ಮೀರಿದರೆ, ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಅನುಮೋದಿತ ಕಂಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಅನ್ನು ನೇಮಿಸಿ, ವೆಚ್ಚದ ರಸೀದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ
ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಕಡಿತ ಮಾಡಲು ಲೆಕ್ಕಪತ್ರ ತಯಾರಿಸಿ
ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದರೆ, ರೆಂಟ್ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ದೂರು ನೀಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ
answer.what_i_dont_know: ಛಾವಣಿ ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲೀಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಪಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ದುರಸ್ತಿ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಎಂದು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆಯೇ? ನೀವು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಮಾಲೀಕರಿಗೆ ಬರಹದ ಸೂಚನೆ ನೀಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ದುರಸ್ತಿಯ ಅಂದಾಜು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಛಾವಣಿ ಹಾನಿಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಏನು?
answer.lawyer_reason: ಬರಹದ ಸೂಚನೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ರಚಿಸುವುದು, ದುರಸ್ತಿಯ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಕಡಿತ ಮಾಡುವ ಲೆಕ್ಕಪತ್ರ, ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಇನ್ನೂ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕು ಹೋರಾಡುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಾಗಿ ವಕೀಲರ ಸಹಾಯ ಅಗತ್ಯ.
